definitions.explanation: The ability to understand something without conscious reasoning.
A natural sense or perception beyond the five senses.

notes:
{勘|かん} refers to intuitive understanding or a gut feeling developed through experience. It is not logical reasoning but rather an instinctive sense.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {勘|かん}が⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧: to have good intuition
- {勘|かん}が⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧: to have poor intuition
- {勘|かん}が⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧: to have sharp intuition
- {勘|かん}が⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: one's intuition kicks in
- {勘|かん}を⟦{頼|たよ}りに→頼る：02069_tayoru⟧: relying on intuition
- {勘|かん}で⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧: to know by instinct

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{勘違|かんちが}い→勘違い：17609_kanchigai⟧: misunderstanding, wrong assumption
- ⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧: calculation; bill (at a restaurant)
- ⟦{勘弁|かんべん}→勘弁：09443_kanben⟧: forgiveness, pardon

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {勘|かん}: intuition (from experience, non-rational)
- ⟦{直感|ちょっかん}→直感：07624_chokkan⟧: intuition (sudden insight, flash of understanding)
- ⟦{予感|よかん}→予感：11416_yokan⟧: premonition, feeling something will happen
